Name: ESTUS_FLASK_RECOVERY_PARAM_ST
Description: Defines the amount HP/MP flasks that will be refilled when an EstusFlaskRecoveryParam row is awarded

Fields.Name: Host
Fields.Description: Flask charges restored to the host, or to any player who is neither a cooperator nor an invader (including offline play).

Fields.Name: Invasion Orb - None
Fields.Description: Flask charges restored to an invader who joined by invading (not by a summon sign).

Fields.Description: The number of est recovery of the power of the orb whose invasion route is

Fields.Description: The number of est recovery of the power of the orb whose invasion route is

Fields.Name: Invasion Sign - None
Fields.Description: Flask charges restored to an invader summoned by a red summon sign (duelist).

Fields.Name: Invasion Sign - Gold
Fields.Description: The number of est recovery of the power whose invasion route is a sign

Fields.Name: Invasion Sign - Berserker
Fields.Description: The number of est recovery of the power whose invasion route is a sign

Fields.Name: Invasion Sign - Sinner
Fields.Description: The number of est recovery of the power whose invasion route is a sign

Fields.Name: Invasion Ring
Fields.Description: Flask charges restored to an invader who joined through a ring-type summon (hunter or guardian join types). Only used while an extra session condition is met; otherwise the invader gets 0.

Fields.Description: The number of est recovery of the power of the ring whose invasion route is

Fields.Description: Flask charges restored to a cooperator summoned by a summon sign (for example with a Furled Finger).

Fields.Name: Coop Sign - Gold
Fields.Description: The number of est recovery of the power whose cooperation route is a sign

Fields.Description: The number of est recovery of the power whose cooperation route is a sign

Fields.Name: Coop Sign - Sinner
Fields.Description: The number of est recovery of the power whose cooperation route is a sign

Fields.Name: Coop Ring - Hunter
Fields.Description: Flask charges restored to a cooperator who joined through a ring (a hunter, as with the Blue Cipher Ring). Only used while an extra session condition is met; otherwise the cooperator gets 0.
